## Quality And Security

- Full PHP tests, PHPStan, Pint, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, production build, and diff checks pass.
- No new route, authorization rule, data model, upload flow, or private-file behavior was introduced.
- The existing YouTube residual URL-sharing risk remains unchanged. Thumbnails are public host metadata and are not treated as video protection.

## Acceptance Boundary

Complete authenticated review of `/classroom` and `/admin/classroom` for both roles, all required responsive widths, light and dark modes, thumbnail rendering, fallback behavior, and no horizontal overflow.
